issues.quote: yesturday i was going to the shop but then the rain was like super heavy so i dont wanted to walk anymore but my friend sayed its fine and we go anyways.
issues.comment: Run-on sentence lacking proper punctuation and sentence division

issues.quote: yesturday i was going to the shop but then the rain was like super heavy so i dont wanted to walk anymore but my friend sayed its fine and we go anyways.
issues.comment: Multiple clauses joined with only coordinating conjunctions; needs clearer sentence boundaries
